conflicts.rationale: Enum member StockStatus.Discontinued is removed; the switch in stock/page.tsx still has a case for it. Enums are not indexed as symbols, so no producer symbol is resolvable.

Method InventoryService.reserve is renamed to hold; stock/page.tsx still calls service.reserve. Independent of the enum change (different member, different repair), on the same producer/consumer pair; class members are not part of the indexed class signature.
